entries.name: Fel Missiles
entries.rationale: The Felonious Mage cast creates dangerous pulsing clones and is a top interrupt target.

entries.name: Seduction
entries.rationale: Interrupt the Sayaad cast; if it completes, remove the resulting Magic control effect.

entries.name: Felstorm
entries.rationale: Kystia's mirror images must be interrupted while the group burns them down.

entries.name: Felstorm
entries.rationale: Alternate Felstorm spell variant used by Kystia's mirror images; handle it with the same interrupt assignment.

entries.name: Fel Rage
entries.rationale: Interrupt the cast because it heavily reduces damage into the mob; soothe the Enrage only as recovery after a missed stop.

entries.name: Health Funnel
entries.rationale: Stop the Fel Invoker from restoring enemy health and extending the pull.

entries.name: Chaos Bolt
entries.rationale: A named important interrupt during Lithiel Cinderfury.

entries.name: Corroding Spittle
entries.rationale: Remove the Magic debuff applied by a Massive Felwyrm.

entries.name: Corroding Spittle
entries.rationale: Remove the boss-context Magic debuff rather than treating its neutral dispel flag as an enemy purge.

entries.name: Curse of Doom
entries.rationale: Remove the Corrupted Warlock's Curse before its delayed punishment.

entries.name: Back to Work!
entries.rationale: Remove the Enrage from affected workers; this is an offensive Enrage removal, not a friendly dispel.

entries.name: Murder in a Row
entries.rationale: Hide behind the preserved Fel Barrel before Zaen fires. The associated channel is unbreakable, so the raw interrupt flag must not become interrupt advice.

provenance.description: Interrupt, dispel, purge, and boss-response priorities were independently summarized from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 dungeon overview.
Spell details identify Murder in a Row as line-of-sight damage and its related channel as unbreakable.
Spell IDs, NPC contexts, interruptibility, dispel flags, and Enrage flags are linked to the generated Midnight Season 2 ability index.
